name: Warehouse Associate (LSC/Q0101, PSSCIVE vocational curriculum, Grades 9-10, 400 hrs)
text:
Introduction to Warehousing (10 hrs)
Picking, Packing, Kitting, Labelling and Binning (35 hrs)
Loading and Unloading of Goods (30 hrs)
Health, Safety and Security (20 hrs)
Handling of Perishable Goods (27 hrs)
Handling of Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (27 hrs)
Handling of Automotive Goods (27 hrs)
Integrity and Ethics (14 hrs)
